title: DART key file, version 1
description: One DART confidential account's secret keys, encrypted with a password (scrypt + XSalsa20-Poly1305, the polkadot.js keyring JSON encoding version 3). Normative text: docs/KEY_FILE_FORMAT.md. This schema checks the JSON structure only; a reader MUST also perform every check in the specification's reader procedure.

type.description: Identifies the file as a DART key file.

version.description: The key file format version. Only 1 is defined.

name.description: A human-readable label for the account. May be empty. Not authenticated by the encryption.

public.description: The account's public keys, each `0x` + lowercase hex of its 32-byte SCALE encoding. MUST equal the public keys inside the decrypted plaintext.

encoded.description: Standard padded base64 (RFC 4648 section 4) of salt[32] || N u32le || p u32le || r u32le || nonce[24] || tag[16] || encrypted plaintext[128]: exactly 212 bytes, so exactly 284 characters ending in a single '='. The final data character carries 2 zero padding bits, so it is one of AEIMQUYcgkosw048.

content.description: The plaintext is one SCALE-encoded DART AccountKeys. Other values (including the reserved "dart-mnemonic") are invalid in version 1.

type.description: scrypt key derivation, then XSalsa20-Poly1305 (NaCl secretbox).

version.description: The polkadot.js keyring JSON encoding version.

meta.description: Unauthenticated, informational metadata. Open: readers MUST ignore members they don't know.

created.description: When the file was written, in Unix milliseconds.

derivationPath.description: Informational only, never used to derive keys: the path the keys were derived at, m/44'/595'/{account}'/0/0 with account a decimal integer from 0 to 2147483647 without leading zeros.
